gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verify that the builder() factory method returns a valid, non-null Builder instance
ADDED i2: Create a semaphore with a 4081-hour period and a negative limit. A limit <= NO_LIMIT (0) disables the cap, so all acquire attempts will succeed.
ADDED i3: tryAcquire() should succeed immediately because the negative limit disables the cap
ADDED i4: Retrieve the raw limit value (still the negative value -1727 as originally set)
ADDED i5: Configure the builder with a period of 0; this would be rejected when build() is called, but setting it on the builder itself is allowed
ADDED i6: getAvailablePermits() = getLimit() - getAcquireCount(); with a negative limit and one successful acquire so far, the result is also negative
ADDED i7: A second tryAcquire() also succeeds because the negative limit still disables the cap
ADDED i8: Record the time unit in the builder for a future build
ADDED i9: Create a second semaphore: pass null for the executor service so the class creates its own internally, use a 1-millisecond period, and set limit=0 (NO_LIMIT) to
ADDED i10: Confirm that the time unit stored in the millisecond semaphore is MILLISECONDS
ADDED i11: Confirm that the first semaphore has not been shut down
ADDED i12: Confirm that the period stored in the millisecond semaphore is 1
